title.narrative: Health, Empowerment, and Rights (HER) Future Project

description.narrative: Health, Empowerment, and Rights (HER) Future Project: A three-year initiative in Morogoro and Arusha regions (Tanzania), led by Pathfinder International and partners. It aims to ensure equitable access to sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) for women, youth, and persons with disabilities by improving quality SRHR services, expanding age-appropriate comprehensive sexuality education, and fostering social and policy acceptance of sexual rights. Implementation period is 2026-2028.
